detail.title: Display device
detail.abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a display device in which a photocurable adhesive can be cured by light from a vertical direction.SOLUTION: A display panel 10 displays an image. A protective panel member 20 allows see-through view of the image. The display panel 10 is adhered to the protective panel member 20 by a photocurable adhesive 15. The protective panel member 20 includes: a translucent substrate 21; a first decorative layer 22 that is formed on a rear surface of the translucent substrate 21; and a light shielding layer 23 that is formed on a rear surface of the first decorative layer 22. A second decorative layer 50 is provided between the display panel 10 and the first decorative layer 22.
